QuestInfo.name: [Museum Master] Museum Master Gold Box
QuestInfo.0: Now that you've collected items for Maple Museums three times in one day, Cassandra has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.2: You filled up museums three times in a single day and received a gift from Cassandra.

0.0: Whoa, did you really complete the #bMuseum Master challenge three times#k in a single day? You're, like, a god or goddess or something. I have even more respect for you than I do for the guys who can transform the news into a number one hit song!
0.1: So, like, do you want a present?

yes.0: Presents are the BEST. Museums are pretty nifty, too, I guess.

no.0: I wonder if those guys can autotune all the clever things I say every day into a song... I'd be a star.

1.0: Are you ready to accept the gift right NOW?

yes.0: Don't open it in front of me, silly! Oh, and come back tomorrow if you manage to achieve the same feat again. There's more prizes where that came from.
